capabilities: group files or folders into a single tab via drag-and-drop or context menus
open recent groups from a left-sidebar history view
expand a group back into separate native tabs
export Markdown group members as one combined local Markdown file
persist group membership and order per saved workspace
extras: Desktop-only; installation is manual (copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the plugins folder). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Exports can write files outside the vault to a chosen computer folder.
problem: Obsidian tabs hold one file each, so working with a set of related files scatters them across the tab strip and navigation history.
summary: Tab manager that combines related files into one native Obsidian tab, with a member popup, recent-group history sidebar, and Markdown export.
